summary: Join our credit risk assessment and pricing training course to develop critical skills and knowledge. Elevate your expertise and advance your career now.
lede: Credit Risk Assessment and Pricing helps professionals evaluate borrower default risk and set rates that reflect expected credit losses and capital costs. You will learn to calculate Probability of Default, Loss Given Default, and Exposure at Default while building risk-based pricing matrices and stress-testing loan portfolios. The course applies quantitative methods including the Altman Z-score, Merton Model, Expected Credit Loss calculations, macroeconomic analysis, and RAROC-driven capital allocation. You will also develop pricing calculators that account for credit value adjustment and capital charges, supporting defensible decisions under IFRS 9, CECL, and Basel IV requirements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for quantitative and commercial finance professionals responsible for evaluating borrower creditworthiness, structuring loan facilities, and managing institutional capital risk.
modules: Credit Risk Foundations and Regulatory Landscape
Advanced Credit Scoring and AI Integration
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of financial mathematics, corporate finance principles, and basic statistical concepts. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required for quantitative exercises. No advanced programming experience is necessary, though familiarity with data analytics concepts is beneficial.
